0022600163.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-5, on a four-game losing streak and 13th in the East) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (6-1, on a three-game winning streak and 1st in the East) for the Bulls' seventh game of the season. Chicago is without Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury, and Dailyn Swain, Jalen Smith and Tobe Awaka are day-to-day with game-time decisions. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), while Joel Embiid is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision. The Bulls won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, but Philadelphia beat Chicago 157-137 in their last meeting, on March 25 in Philadelphia, and the teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series.
